name: @jiscribe/standard-shapes
description: The shipped shape set as one package: the eight standard shape plugins, bundled once for every host to register

comments.exports: ./doc is the headless half (parsing, doc-ops, schema generation) and pulls in no react; the root entry is the half a canvas is rendered with. A Node host importing the root entry would drag react into a process that has no DOM, which is what the split prevents.
